(men's basketball)|Beşiktaş]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Oral Roberts Golden Eagles men's basketball|Oral Roberts Golden Eagles]], [[Western Texas College|Western Texas Westerners]], and [[Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball|Tulsa Golden Hurricane]]. ==College career== Jeffries played at [[Oral Roberts Golden Eagles men's basketball|Oral Roberts]] and [[Western Texas College]] before transferring to [[Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball|Tulsa]], where he played two seasons of [[college basketball]]. As a senior, he averaged 13 points and 5.6 rebounds per game and was named to the Third-team All-[[American Athletic Conference]]. After the season, Jeffries took part in the [[Portsmouth Invitational Tournament]].{{cite news |title=TU's DaQuan Jeffries signs free agent contract with Orlando Magic |url=https://www.tulsaworld.com/sports/college/tu/tu-s-daquan-jeffries-signs-free-agent-contract-with-orlando/article_29de148f-ae96-5b2b-8454-3749ff2e9227.html |accessdate=November 12, 2019 |work=[[Tulsa World]] |date=June 21, 2019}} ==Professional career== Originally projected as a second-round pick, Jeffries went undrafted in the [[2019 NBA draft]]. He signed with the [[Orlando Magic]] on June 21, 2019.{{Cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/magic/magic-sign-free-agents-daquan-jeffries-and-vic-law-20190730|title=Magic Sign Free Agents DaQuan Jeffries and Vic Law|website=Orlando Magic|language=en|access-date=October 12, 2019}} Reportedly, he declined a two-way deal in order to compete for a roster spot with the team.{{Cite web|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2019/07/24/daquan-jeffries-declined-two-way-deal-to-compete-for-magic-roster-spot/|title=DaQuan Jeffries declined two-way deal to compete for Magic roster spot|date=July 24, 2019|website=The Rookie Wire|language=en|access-date=October 12, 2019}} On October 19, 2019, the Magic released Jeffries.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/daquan-jeffries-waived-by-orlando/|title=DaQuan Jeffries: Waived by Orlando|website=CBSSports.com}} ===Sacramento Kings (2019–2021)=== Jeffries then signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Sacramento Kings]] on October 21, 2019.{{cite web|title=Kings Announce Roster Moves Wenyen Gabriel Elevated to Roster Spot, DaQuan Jeffries Added as Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/blog/kings-announce-roster-moves|date=October 21, 2019|website=NBA.com|accessdate=October 21, 2019}} Under the terms of the deal he will split time between the Kings and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Stockton Kings]]. On December 13, Jeffries tallied 44 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for Stockton in a victory over the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]].{{cite news |title=Kings' DaQuan Jeffries: Explodes for 44 points Friday |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/kings-daquan-jeffries-explodes-for-44-points-friday/ |accessdate=January 27, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=December 14, 2019}} He suffered an undisclosed injury later in December.{{cite news |title=Kings' DaQuan Jeffries: Struggles in return from injury |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/kings-daquan-jeffries-struggles-in-return-from-injury/ |accessdate=January 27, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=December 22, 2019}} On November 28, 2020, Jeffries was signed to a standard contract by the Kings.{{cite news|title=Kings Re-Sign DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-re-sign-daquan-jeffries|accessdate=April 3, 2021|work=NBA.com|date=November 28, 2020}} On April 3, 2021, Jeffries was waived by the Kings. He appeared in 31 games in two seasons.{{cite news|title=Kings Waive DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-waive-daquan-jeffries|accessdate=April 3, 2021|work=NBA.com|date=April 3, 2021}} ===Houston Rockets (2021)=== On April 5, 2021, the [[Houston Rockets]] claimed Jeffries off waivers.{{cite web|title=Rockets Claim DaQuan Jeffries off Waivers|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-claim-daquan-jeffries-waivers|date=April 5, 2021|website=NBA.com|accessdate=April 5, 2021}} On May 13, he was waived by the Rockets after 13 appearances.{{cite tweet|number=1392966026837565440|user=HoustonRockets|title=Roster Update: The Rockets have waived guard/forward DaQuan Jeffries; he appeared in 13 games with three starts as a Rocket.|date=May 13, 2021|author=Houston Rockets|accessdate=May 13, 2021}} ===College Park Skyhawks (2021–2022)=== On May 15, 2021, the [[San Antonio Spurs]] claimed Jeffries off waivers.{{cite tweet|number=1393687134008188933|user=TheTyJager|title=The Spurs claimed forward DaQuan Jeffries as there is only more scheduled game in the regular season before their Play-In game scheduled for Wednesday.|date=May 15, 2021|author=Ty Jäger|accessdate=May 16, 2021}} On October 7, 2021, the [[Atlanta Hawks]] signed Jeffries.{{cite web|title=Hawks Request Waivers On A.J. Lawson, Sign Daquan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/hawks-request-waivers-aj-lawson-sign-daquan-jeffries|website=NBA.com|date=October 7, 2021|access-date=October 7, 2021}} However, he was waived on October 15.{{cite web|title=Atlanta Hawks Request Waivers on Johnny Hamilton, DaQuan Jeffries and Ibi Watson|url=https://www.nba.com/hawks/news/atlanta-hawks-request-waivers-johnny-hamilton-daquan-jeffries-and-ibi-watson|website=NBA.com|date=October 15, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} In October 2021, Jeffries signed with the [[College Park Skyhawks]].{{cite news |title=College Park Skyhawks fall in preseason scrimmage |url=https://www.news-daily.com/sports/college-park-skyhawks-fall-in-preseason-scrimmage/article_d761010e-39c7-11ec-80d5-cfd35a4dd6f8.html |access-date=November 3, 2021 |work=[[Clayton News-Daily]] |date=October 30, 2021}} He averaged 15.4 points and 2.4 rebounds per game. ===Memphis Grizzlies (2022)=== On January 1, 2022, Jeffries signed a 10-day contract with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] via the hardship exemption.{{cite news|title=Grizzlies' DaQuan Jeffries: Signs with Grizzlies|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/grizzlies-daquan-jeffries-signs-with-grizzlies/|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=January 1, 2022|access-date=January 1, 2022}} He appeared in three games during this stint, scoring 2 total points. On January 11, 2022, Jeffries was reacquired by the [[College Park Skyhawks]].{{cite web|title=2021-22 NBA G League transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=NBA.com|access-date=January 11, 2022}} ===New York / Westchester Knicks (2022–2024)=== On September 15, 2022, Jeffries signed with the [[New York Knicks]],{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries|website=NBA.com|date=September 15, 2022|access-date=September 15, 2022}} but was waived at the end of training camp.{{cite tweet|author=NEW YORK KNICKS|title=Knicks waive Akinjo, Harris, and Jeffries.|number=1581385694433329152|user=nyknicks|date=October 15, 2022|access-date=October 16, 2022}} On October 24, he joined the [[Westchester Knicks]].{{cite web|title=Westchester Knicks Announce 2022-23 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/westchester-knicks-announce-2022-23-training-camp-roster/n-5892760|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 23, 2022|access-date=October 23, 2022}} On November 29, 2022, Jeffries signed a [[two-way contract]] with the New York Knicks after playing well for their NBA G League team, the Westchester Knicks.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/knicks/news/new-york-knicks-daquan-jeffries-g-league-tom-thibodeau-westchester|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries to Two-Way Deal After Strong Play in G-League|website=SI.com|date=November 29, 2022|access-date=November 29, 2022}} On March 5, 2023, the Knicks converted Jeffries' deal to a 10-day contract,{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 5, 2023|access-date=March 19, 2023}} then signed him to a second 10-day contract on March 16{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries to Second 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries-to-second-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 16, 2023|access-date=March 19, 2023}} and on March 26, they signed him to a standard deal.{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries-2|website=NBA.com|date=March 26, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}} On December 30, 2023, Jeffries was waived by the New York Knicks.{{cite tweet|author=NY_KnicksPR|title=Knicks waive DaQuan Jeffries|number=1741201508270518643|user=NY_KnicksPR|date=December 30, 2023|access-date=January 3, 2024}} On January 2, 2024, Jeffries re-joined the Westchester Knicks{{cite web|title=Westchester Knicks Acquire DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://westchester.gleague.nba.com/news/westchester-knicks-acquire-daquan-jeffries|website=NBA.com|date=January 2, 2024|access-date=January 3, 2024}} and on February 22, he was signed to a 10-day contract.{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries-to-10-day-contract-2|website=NBA.com|date=February 22, 2024|access-date=February 22, 2024}} On March 3, he returned to Westchester{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Westchester Knicks Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Westchester-Knicks/40/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=March 3, 2024}} and on March 14, he rejoined New York on another 10-day contract.{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries-to-10-day-contract-3|website=NBA.com|date=March 14, 2024|access-date=March 14, 2024}} On March 25, he signed with New York for the rest of the season.{{cite web|title=New York Knicks Sign DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/new-york-knicks-sign-daquan-jeffries|website=NBA.com|date=March 25, 2024|access-date=March 25, 2024}} ===Charlotte Hornets (2024–2025)=== On October 2, 2024, Jeffries was signed and traded to the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in a three team trade involving the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] in which Minnesota acquired [[Keita Bates-Diop]], [[Donte DiVincenzo]], [[Julius Randle]], and one Lottery Protected first-round pick. The Hornets also received [[Charlie Brown Jr. (basketball)|Charlie Brown Jr.]], [[Duane Washington Jr.]], three second-round picks and draft compensation. New York acquired [[Karl-Anthony Towns]] and the draft rights to [[James Nnaji]].{{cite web|title=Hornets Acquire Three Picks, Three Players In Three-Team Trade|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-acquire-three-picks-three-players-in-three-team-trade|website=NBA.com|date=October 2, 2024|access-date=October 2, 2024}} He made 47 appearances (20 starts) for Charlotte during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging a career-high 6.7 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 1.1 assists. On September 18, 2025, Jeffries was waived by the Hornets.{{Cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets Waive DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://www.nba.com/hornets/news/charlotte-hornets-waive-daquan-jeffries|access-date=October 12, 2025|website=nba.com|language=en}} ===Sacramento / Stockton Kings (2025–2026)=== On October 15, 2025, Jeffries signed a training camp contract with the [[Sacramento Kings]].{{Cite web|title=DaQuan Jeffries: Joining Sacramento|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/daquan-jeffries-joining-sacramento/|access-date=October 23, 2025|website=cbssports.com|language=en}} That same day, his rights were traded from the [[Westchester Knicks]] to the [[Stockton Kings]] in exchange for the rights to Terry Thomas and Jalen Thomas, as well as Stockton's 2026 first-round pick.{{Cite web|title=Stockton Kings Acquire Returning Player Rights to DaQuan Jeffries|url=https://stockton.gleague.nba.com/news/stockton-kings-acquire-returning-player-rights-to-daquan-jeffries|access-date=October 23, 2025|website=stockton.gleague.nba.com|language=en}} Jeffries was waived by Sacramento the following day, with expectations that he would join Stockton.{{cite web | title=DaQuan Jeffries: Waived by Sacramento | website=CBS Sports | date=2025-10-16 | url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/daquan-jeffries-waived-by-sacramento/ | access-date=2025-12-08}} On March 26, 2026, Sacramento signed Jeffries to a 10-day contract after the team suffered multiple injuries.{{Cite web|title=Sacramento Kings Sign DaQuan Jeffries To 10-Day Contract|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/sacramento-kings-sign-daquan-jeffries-to-10-day-contract|access-date=March 30, 2026|website=gleague.nba.com|language=en}} He played in three games for Sacramento, recording averages of 10.3 points, 1.7 rebounds, and 0.3 assists. ===Beşiktaş (2026–present)=== On July 11, 2026, Jeffries signed with [[Beşiktaş J.K. (men's basketball)|Beşiktaş]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=BJK_Basketbol |number=2075870729304756716 |title=Resmi Açıklama DaQuan Jeffries}} ==Career statistics==
